description: This file defines the 'ConnectorType' class template and the 'ConnectorController' class within the Thunder::RPC namespace. It provides mechanisms for managing communication channels and a singleton controller for connectors, including methods for acquiring interfaces, managing communication channels, and controlling operational state.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: A singleton class managing a controller interface, providing methods to announce, revoke, and access the controller.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: A template class managing communication channels to remote nodes, providing interface acquisition, channel management, and operational control.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectorController.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Sets and adds reference to the controller interface.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Releases and clears the controller interface.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Returns the current controller interface, adding a reference if not null.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires an interface of specified type from a communication channel to a remote node.

methods.name: Communicator
methods.description: Returns the communication client proxy for a given node.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Returns a reference to the engine (IIPCServer) instance.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Sets the operational state of the connector (no implementation provided).
